brief_summary: Three side-by-side cross-sections of keycap stem interiors — MX cruciform post, Alps twin rectangular-blade stem, and low-profile/Choc shortened cruciform post — each labeled with the switch family it fits, closing on the 'turn the cap over and check' annotation.
data_sources: artisan-keycaps-buying-guide.mdx § 'Stems: turn it over before you buy' — 'MX-stem caps have a plus-shaped cruciform post molded into the underside that slots onto the switch's cross-shaped stem — the stem the overwhelming majority of artisan makers sculpt for.'
artisan-keycaps-buying-guide.mdx § 'Stems: turn it over before you buy' — 'uses Alps-style switches, which take a completely different stem: two narrow rectangular blades rather than a cross.'

artisan-keycaps-buying-guide.mdx § 'Stems: turn it over before you buy' — 'Low-profile switches ... use a shorter stem geometry of their own, incompatible with full-height MX caps even when the cross shape looks similar at a glance.'
artisan-keycaps-buying-guide.mdx § 'Stems: turn it over before you buy' — 'turn the cap over and look at the stem, and compare it against a known-compatible cap already on the board.'
